title: Estimation of Preference Heterogeneity in Markets with Costly Search
authors: Ilya Morozov; Stephan Seiler; Xiaojing Dong; Liwen Hou
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Structural consumer search model (preferences and search costs) estimated by simulated likelihood with importance sampling; pricing counterfactuals.
design_notes: MATLAB folders model_different_costs (main), model_search, model_nosearch, model_correlation, model_pricing, model_simulated (Monte Carlo on artificial data). No regressions with treatment timing.
data_files: input/table.mat lookup tables of reservation utilities only
data_files_note: readme.txt: real data removed from input folders under NDA; model_simulated generates artificial data.
data_provenance_note: Real data removed; only code that simulates artificial data.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
